name: Transfiguration
overview: The Transfiguration reveals a divine radiance that signifies God's glory and presence, as demonstrated in the transformation of Moses' face after speaking with the LORD on Mount Sinai. When Moses descended, his face shone so brightly that the Israelites were afraid to approach him until he veiled it, underscoring both the holiness of God and the mediatorial role Moses played. This event highlights the tangible manifestation of God's glory to His people and sets a precedent for understanding other transfigurations, including that of Jesus and Stephen.
